english.title: Possess live / dead non-Schedule 1 wild bird or parts
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), had in your possession or control

(A)_[a live wild bird,]_
(B)_[a dead wild bird,]_
(C)_[live wild birds,]_
(D)_[dead wild birds,]_
(E)_[part or parts of or anything derived from a wild bird,]_
(F)_[parts of or anything derived from wild birds,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE SPECIES OF BIRD(S)..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 1(2)(a) and 21(1) of the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See Section 1(3) for defence and Section 4 for exceptions.
(ii) See Sections 1(6) and 27 for meaning of "wild bird".
(iii) See Section 21(6) for the forfeiture provisions.
(iv) See Section 21(7) for place where offence deemed to have been committed for jurisdiction purposes.
(v) As amended by paragraph 10 of Schedule 12 to the Countryside and Rights of Way Act 2000.

other.penalty:
Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Where more than one animal is involved in a single offence the maximum fine shall be determined as if the person convicted had been convicted of a separate offence in respect of each animal (Section 21(5)).

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see legislation
